description: This file defines a Java class 'MockWarningDeviceCluster' that extends 'MockCluster'. It appears to be part of a testing or mocking framework for device clusters, specifically for warning devices, within the Zith project. The class sets up constants for command IDs, a constructor that initializes the cluster, and a method to handle commands based on command IDs, though the actual handling logic is marked as TODO.
